His head height from the ground is therefore markedly lower than an adult's head height.

- A high-five requires both hands to be at approximately the same height. Keeping each hand at its owner's head height preserves the roughly 30-40 cm child-versus-adult height difference, leaving the hands vertically separated by that difference.
